Meet Lucia

Clinical writing is heavy work. Turn on distraction mode and Claria’s mascot keeps you company below each client workspace.

Say hello

Turn her on in Preferences, click her for a silent woof, drop her a sock to chase, and hide her with the × whenever you need to focus.

Watch and feed

In Watch mode she follows your pointer. In Feed mode she eats up to five dekopon, getting a little rounder with each one.

A day with Lucia

She stretches, naps, twirls and skateboards while you work, perks up when you type, and reads the paper while Claria is thinking.

Lucia is silent, runs entirely on your Mac, and never sees client data. These clips show the next release; turn her on under Preferences → General → Distraction mode.
